create.name: Light of the Spirit Monastery
create.bio:
Light of the Spirit Monastery, also called Atma Jyoti Ashram, is a small community of monks in Cedar Crest, New Mexico, led by its abbot, Swami Nirmalananda Giri (Abbot George Burke). The monks belong to the Giri branch of the Shankara order of sannyasis, and their day starts with three hours of meditation. Their outlook draws on the Upanishads, the Bhagavad Gita, the Yoga Sutras and Sankhya philosophy, and they also write about what they call Original Christianity, reading the Gospels alongside the yogic traditions of India.

The monastery reaches people mainly through its website, OCOY.org, and its YouTube channel, Light of the Spirit, which has run since 2007. The channel carries the abbot's monthly video satsangs, a long series of Gita talks, short commentaries on the sayings of Anandamayi Ma, and pilgrimage films from India. The website adds articles, a weekly blog, recorded podcasts and a free e-library of the monastery's books as PDF downloads, with an introduction to Soham meditation for beginners.

free_resources.title: How to Meditate: An Introduction to Soham Yoga Meditation
free_resources.description: A free written guide to the monastery's main practice, Soham meditation, explaining its roots in the Upanishads and the Nath yogis and how to begin.

free_resources.title: E-Library of free ebooks
free_resources.description: Free PDF downloads of the monastery's books on yoga, the Gita, other scriptures and the Christian mystical tradition, with paperbacks available to buy.

free_resources.title: Spiritual podcasts
free_resources.description: Free recorded talks by Swami Nirmalananda Giri on meditation, practical spiritual life and the saints and teachers he has met.

free_resources.title: Video satsangs and Gita talks
free_resources.description: A page gathering the abbot's monthly satsangs, his series of talks on the Bhagavad Gita and shorter inspirational videos.
